' THE GHOST - Ghost Saga, Act 1: "We begin". A submarine game for the ZX Spectrum Next in NTC BASIC.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Mr Bad stole the Ghost Sub and took a new name: The Ghost. You are him. The Ten are your crew -
' and your lives: each hit on the hull loses one. A Russian and an American patrol are hunting the
' boat they lost. Sink the patrol, then take the Ghost Sub to the wreck: the signal is there.
'
' Keys: O P turn, Q A throttle up / down, K M rise / dive, Space torpedo, S sonar ping.
'       Kempston: left / right turn, up / down rise / dive, fire torpedo.
' Running fast is loud - they hear you further off. A ping shows them all on the radar for a
' while, and tells them all where you are.
'
' The sea floor is blocks drawn by Vox (filled faces on Layer 2, near to far, murk beyond 12
' blocks); the subs, torpedoes, fish and blasts are hardware sprites; the panel and the chessboard
' radar are the tilemap; the sound is the AY.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const NE = 3, NT = 5, NF = 4, NB = 3
' sprite slots
Const SP_SIGHT = 0, SP_SUB = 1, SP_TORP = 4, SP_FISH = 9, SP_BLAST = 13, SP_RME = 20, SP_RSUB = 21, SP_RTORP = 24, SP_RGOAL = 29
' the view on screen (sprite coordinates) and the radar
Const VX0 = 32, VY0 = 48, RX0 = 224, RY0 = 48

Dim longText As String Max 120
' the Ghost Sub
Dim px As Integer, py As Integer, pz As Integer, yaw As Integer, pitch As Integer, thr As Integer
Dim crew As Integer, torps As Integer, reload As Integer, cool As Integer, pingT As Integer, pingCool As Integer
Dim noise As Integer, sunk As Integer, phase As Integer, layer As Integer, hitFlash As Integer
' the patrol: position, heading, life, state (0 sunk, 1 patrol, 2 hunting), cool-down, side (0 Russian, 1 American)
Dim ex(2) As Integer, ey(2) As Integer, ez(2) As Integer, eyaw(2) As Integer, est(2) As Integer, ecool(2) As Integer, eside(2) As Integer, eturn(2) As Integer
' torpedoes: position, velocity, life (0 = none), whose (0 the Ghost, 1 the patrol)
Dim tx(4) As Integer, ty(4) As Integer, tz(4) As Integer, tvx(4) As Integer, tvy(4) As Integer, tvz(4) As Integer, tlife(4) As Integer, town(4) As Integer
' fish
Dim fx(3) As Integer, fy(3) As Integer, fz(3) As Integer, fvx(3) As Integer, fvz(3) As Integer
' blasts
Dim bx(2) As Integer, by(2) As Integer, bz(2) As Integer, bt(2) As Integer
Dim t As Integer, tLast As Integer, dt As Integer, frames As Integer, fireWas As Integer, pingWas As Integer, thrWas As Integer
Dim i As Integer, j As Integer, k As Integer, d As Integer, s As Integer, c As Integer, a As Integer, msgT As Integer
Dim heardOnce As Integer

Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Vox.Screen &HE3                    ' Layer 2 see-through except the view (the panels are the tilemap)
Vox.Load World.Base()
Vox.Colours World.Colours()
Vox.Build

Do
  Title
  NewGame
  Play
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title: the Ghost Shell
Sub Title()
  Dim y As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 32 : Spr.Show
  Tiles.Fill GfxData.T_PANEL
  Tiles.Text 6, 5, "CYBORGSHELL V1.0."
  Tiles.Text 6, 6, "BY PRIMALNINJA."
  Tiles.Text 6, 7, "LOCAL STORAGE IS AVAILABLE."
  Tiles.Text 6, 8, "YOU ARE LOGGED IN."
  Tiles.Text 6, 9, "READY."
  Tiles.Text 6, 11, "LOAD " & Chr$(34) & "THE GHOST" & Chr$(34)
  Tiles.Text 6, 12, "RUN"
  Tiles.Text 6, 14, "GHOST SAGA - ACT 1: WE BEGIN"
  Tiles.Text 6, 16, "FIRST, OPEN THE DOOR"
  Tiles.Text 6, 17, "SECOND, WATCH THE ROAD"
  Tiles.Text 6, 18, "THIRD, ERASE THE TRACE"
  Tiles.Text 6, 19, "...TENTH, MOVE."
  Tiles.Text 6, 21, "TEN FOR THE GHOST."
  Tiles.Text 6, 24, "O P TURN   Q A THROTTLE"
  Tiles.Text 6, 25, "K M RISE / DIVE"
  Tiles.Text 6, 26, "SPACE TORPEDO   S SONAR PING"
  Tiles.Text 6, 28, "PRESS SPACE TO DIVE"
  ' (Layer 2's view off while the title is up: see-through everywhere)
  Do
    Frame
    Sfx.Update
  Loop While Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace)
  y = 0
  Do
    Frame
    y = y + 1
    If y = 25 Then Tiles.Text 6, 28, "                   "
    If y = 50 Then Tiles.Text 6, 28, "PRESS SPACE TO DIVE" : y = 0
  Loop Until Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or (Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1)
  Sfx.Play 0, 60, 2, 15, 30, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a new game
Sub NewGame()
  px = 2 * 256 + 128 : py = 6 * 256 + 128 : pz = 1 * 256 + 128 : yaw = 16 : pitch = -4 : thr = 1
  crew = 10 : torps = 6 : reload = 0 : cool = 0 : pingT = 0 : pingCool = 0 : sunk = 0 : phase = 0
  layer = -1 : hitFlash = 0 : heardOnce = 0 : msgT = 0 : fireWas = 1 : pingWas = 1 : thrWas = 1
  SetSub 0, 3 * 256 + 128, 6 * 256 + 128, 13 * 256 + 128, 64, 0
  SetSub 1, 13 * 256 + 128, 8 * 256 + 128, 13 * 256 + 128, 192, 1
  SetSub 2, 12 * 256 + 128, 13 * 256 + 128, 8 * 256 + 128, 128, 0
  For i = 0 To NT - 1
    tlife(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 0 To NB - 1
    bt(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 0 To NF - 1
    fx(i) = (2 + i * 4) * 256 + 77 : fy(i) = (4 + i) * 256 : fz(i) = (4 + (i * 5) Mod 9) * 256 : fvx(i) = 3 - i * 2 : fvz(i) = 2 + i
  Next
  Panel
End Sub

Sub SetSub(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal side As Integer)
  ex(n) = x : ey(n) = y : ez(n) = z : eyaw(n) = h : est(n) = 1 : ecool(n) = 100 + n * 50 : eside(n) = side : eturn(n) = 1
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the panel round the view
Sub Panel()
  Tiles.Fill GfxData.T_PANEL
  Tiles.Rect 4, 6, 24, 20, GfxData.T_BLACK          ' under the view (Layer 2 covers it)
  Tiles.Text 4, 4, "THE GHOST  ACT 1: WE BEGIN"
  Tiles.Text 28, 14, "DEPTH"
  Tiles.Text 28, 16, "SPEED"
  Tiles.Text 28, 18, "NOISE"
  Tiles.Text 28, 20, "TORPS"
  Tiles.Text 28, 22, "THE TEN"
  ShowSunk
  ShowCrew
  ShowTorps
  Say "SIGNAL LOCKED. DIVE, DIVE, DIVE!"
End Sub

Sub ShowSunk()
  Tiles.Text 28, 5, "SUNK " & Trim$(Str$(sunk)) & "/3"
End Sub

Sub ShowCrew()
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To 9
    If n < crew Then Tiles.Put 28 + (n Mod 5), 23 + n \ 5, GfxData.T_CREW Else Tiles.Put 28 + (n Mod 5), 23 + n \ 5, GfxData.T_CREWX
  Next
End Sub

Sub ShowTorps()
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To 5
    If n < torps Then Tiles.Put 28 + n, 21, GfxData.T_TORP Else Tiles.Put 28 + n, 21, GfxData.T_TUBE
  Next
End Sub

' a bar of v (0-64) at x, y over 8 cells
Sub Bar(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer, f As Integer
  For n = 0 To 7
    f = v - n * 8
    If f < 0 Then f = 0
    If f > 8 Then f = 8
    Tiles.Put x + n, y, GfxData.T_BAR + f
  Next
End Sub

' a line of text at the bottom
Sub Say(ByVal m As String)
  longText = m
  Tiles.Rect 4, 26, 32, 2, GfxData.T_PANEL
  Tiles.Text 4, 26, Left$(longText, 32)
  If Len(longText) > 32 Then Tiles.Text 4, 27, Mid$(longText, 33, 32)
  msgT = 400
End Sub

' the chessboard: 8 x 8 squares of 2 x 2 blocks at the Ghost's depth (rock shown)
Sub Radar()
  Dim sx As Integer, sz As Integer, rock As Integer
  For sz = 0 To 7
    For sx = 0 To 7
      rock = Vox.GetBlock(sx * 2, layer, sz * 2) Or Vox.GetBlock(sx * 2 + 1, layer, sz * 2) Or Vox.GetBlock(sx * 2, layer, sz * 2 + 1) Or Vox.GetBlock(sx * 2 + 1, layer, sz * 2 + 1)
      If (sx + sz) And 1 Then
        If rock Then Tiles.Put 28 + sx, 13 - sz, GfxData.T_ROCKD Else Tiles.Put 28 + sx, 13 - sz, GfxData.T_SQD
      Else
        If rock Then Tiles.Put 28 + sx, 13 - sz, GfxData.T_ROCKL Else Tiles.Put 28 + sx, 13 - sz, GfxData.T_SQL
      End If
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the game
Sub Play()
  tLast = Vox.Ticks()
  Do
    t = Vox.Ticks()
    dt = t - tLast
    tLast = t
    If dt < 1 Then dt = 1
    If dt > 6 Then dt = 6
    Controls
    MoveGhost
    MovePatrol
    MoveTorps
    MoveFish
    For i = 0 To NB - 1
      If bt(i) > 0 Then bt(i) = bt(i) - dt
    Next
    If layer <> py \ 256 Then layer = py \ 256 : Radar
    Vox.Render px, py + 64, pz, yaw, pitch, Vox.Page()
    Sprites
    Hud
    Frame : Vox.Flip
    frames = frames + 1
    For i = 1 To dt
      Sfx.Update
    Next
    If crew <= 0 Then
      Say "THE TEN ARE GONE. THE GHOST IS ALONE."
      Ending
      Exit Sub
    End If
    If phase = 1 Then
      d = Abs(px - (12 * 256 + 128)) + Abs(py - 4 * 256) + Abs(pz - 11 * 256)
      If d < 500 Then
        Say "WE BEGIN. THE GHOST IS CALLING."
        Ending
        Exit Sub
      End If
    End If
  Loop
End Sub

Sub Ending()
  Dim n As Integer
  Sfx.Play 1, 40, 1, 15, 60, 0
  For n = 1 To 200
    Frame
    Sfx.Update
  Next
End Sub

Sub Controls()
  Dim j0 As Integer, fire As Integer, ping As Integer, up As Integer, down As Integer
  j0 = Keys.Joystick(0)
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyLeft) Then yaw = (yaw - 2 * dt) And 255
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyRight) Then yaw = (yaw + 2 * dt) And 255
  ' throttle: one step a press
  up = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) : down = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA)
  If up And thrWas = 0 And thr < 3 Then thr = thr + 1
  If down And thrWas = 0 And thr > 0 Then thr = thr - 1
  thrWas = up Or down
  pitch = -4
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyK) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyUp) Then MoveTo px, py + 8 * dt, pz : pitch = 6
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyDown) Then MoveTo px, py - 8 * dt, pz : pitch = -14
  fire = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyFire1)
  If fire And fireWas = 0 And cool <= 0 And torps > 0 Then Shoot
  fireWas = fire
  ping = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyS)
  If ping And pingWas = 0 And pingCool <= 0 Then
    pingT = 400 : pingCool = 600
    Sfx.Play 2, 30, 0, 15, 40, 0
    Say "SONAR PING... PING..."
    For i = 0 To NE - 1
      If est(i) = 1 Then est(i) = 2
    Next
  End If
  pingWas = ping
End Sub

' the Ghost Sub moves to x, y, z unless a block is in the way
Sub MoveTo(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer)
  If x < 96 Or x > 4000 Or z < 96 Or z > 4000 Or y < 96 Or y > 3900 Then Exit Sub
  If Vox.Solid(x, y, z) Then Exit Sub
  If Vox.Solid(x, y + 96, z) Then Exit Sub
  px = x : py = y : pz = z
End Sub

Sub MoveGhost()
  s = thr * 5 * dt
  If s Then MoveTo px + Vox.Sine(yaw) * s \ 127, py, pz + Vox.Sine(yaw + 64) * s \ 127
  noise = thr * 16 + 8
  If cool > 0 Then cool = cool - dt
  If pingT > 0 Then pingT = pingT - dt
  If pingCool > 0 Then pingCool = pingCool - dt
  If hitFlash > 0 Then hitFlash = hitFlash - dt
  If msgT > 0 Then
    msgT = msgT - dt
    If msgT <= 0 Then Tiles.Rect 4, 26, 32, 2, GfxData.T_PANEL
  End If
  If torps < 6 Then
    reload = reload + dt
    If reload > 250 Then reload = 0 : torps = torps + 1 : ShowTorps
  End If
End Sub

Sub Shoot()
  For k = 0 To NT - 1
    If tlife(k) <= 0 Then
      tx(k) = px : ty(k) = py : tz(k) = pz
      tvx(k) = Vox.Sine(yaw) * 36 \ 127 : tvy(k) = 0 : tvz(k) = Vox.Sine(yaw + 64) * 36 \ 127
      tlife(k) = 160 : town(k) = 0
      torps = torps - 1 : cool = 30 : ShowTorps
      Sfx.Play 1, 0, 0, 13, 20, 1
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the patrol
Sub MovePatrol()
  Dim n As Integer, dx As Integer, dy As Integer, dz As Integer, hear As Integer, sp As Integer, fwx As Integer, fwz As Integer, cr As Integer, dot As Integer
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    If est(n) Then
      dx = px - ex(n) : dy = py - ey(n) : dz = pz - ez(n)
      d = Abs(dx) + Abs(dy) + Abs(dz)
      hear = 700 + noise * 30
      If pingT > 0 Then hear = 3000
      If d < hear And est(n) = 1 Then
        est(n) = 2
        If heardOnce = 0 Then heardOnce = 1 : Say "SONAR PING... TARGET: YOU." : Sfx.Play 2, 40, 0, 12, 30, 0
      End If
      If est(n) = 2 And d > hear + 2000 Then est(n) = 1
      fwx = Vox.Sine(eyaw(n)) : fwz = Vox.Sine(eyaw(n) + 64)
      sp = 3
      If est(n) = 2 Then
        sp = 5
        ' turn towards the Ghost (the cross product's sign), rise or dive to his depth
        cr = fwx * (dz \ 32) - fwz * (dx \ 32)
        If cr > 0 Then eyaw(n) = (eyaw(n) - dt) And 255 Else eyaw(n) = (eyaw(n) + dt) And 255
        If dy > 64 And Vox.Solid(ex(n), ey(n) + 200, ez(n)) = 0 Then ey(n) = ey(n) + 3 * dt
        If dy < -64 And Vox.Solid(ex(n), ey(n) - 200, ez(n)) = 0 Then ey(n) = ey(n) - 3 * dt
        ' fire when facing him, near, and in sight
        dot = fwx * (dx \ 32) + fwz * (dz \ 32)
        If ecool(n) > 0 Then ecool(n) = ecool(n) - dt
        If ecool(n) <= 0 And d < 2600 And dot > 0 Then
          If Vox.Sight(ex(n), ey(n), ez(n), px, py, pz) Then EnemyShot n, dx, dy, dz, d : ecool(n) = 220
        End If
      End If
      ' ahead blocked (or the map's edge): turn away
      If Vox.Solid(ex(n) + fwx * 3, ey(n), ez(n) + fwz * 3) Then
        ' hunting: over the top if there's water above, else turn away
        If est(n) = 2 And ey(n) < 3700 And Vox.Solid(ex(n), ey(n) + 300, ez(n)) = 0 Then
          ey(n) = ey(n) + 8 * dt
        Else
          eyaw(n) = (eyaw(n) + 48 * eturn(n)) And 255
          If (t And 7) = 0 Then eturn(n) = -eturn(n)
        End If
      Else
        ex(n) = ex(n) + fwx * sp * dt \ 127 : ez(n) = ez(n) + fwz * sp * dt \ 127
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub EnemyShot(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal dx As Integer, ByVal dy As Integer, ByVal dz As Integer, ByVal dd As Integer)
  Dim m As Integer
  For m = 0 To NT - 1
    If tlife(m) <= 0 Then
      dd = dd \ 16 + 1
      tx(m) = ex(n) : ty(m) = ey(n) : tz(m) = ez(n)
      tvx(m) = (dx \ 16) * 30 \ dd : tvy(m) = (dy \ 16) * 30 \ dd : tvz(m) = (dz \ 16) * 30 \ dd
      tlife(m) = 200 : town(m) = 1
      Sfx.Play 1, 0, 0, 10, 20, 1
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- torpedoes, blasts, fish
Sub MoveTorps()
  Dim n As Integer, m As Integer
  For n = 0 To NT - 1
    If tlife(n) > 0 Then
      tx(n) = tx(n) + tvx(n) * dt : ty(n) = ty(n) + tvy(n) * dt : tz(n) = tz(n) + tvz(n) * dt
      tlife(n) = tlife(n) - dt
      If Vox.Solid(tx(n), ty(n), tz(n)) Then
        Blast tx(n), ty(n), tz(n) : tlife(n) = 0
      ElseIf town(n) = 0 Then
        For m = 0 To NE - 1
          If est(m) Then
            If Abs(tx(n) - ex(m)) + Abs(ty(n) - ey(m)) + Abs(tz(n) - ez(m)) < 260 Then
              Blast ex(m), ey(m), ez(m) : tlife(n) = 0 : est(m) = 0
              sunk = sunk + 1 : ShowSunk
              If sunk = 3 Then
                phase = 1
                Say "TEN FOR THE GHOST! THE PATROL IS DOWN. TO THE WRECK."
              Else
                Say "TARGET DOWN."
              End If
            End If
          End If
        Next
      ElseIf Abs(tx(n) - px) + Abs(ty(n) - py) + Abs(tz(n) - pz) < 240 Then
        Blast tx(n), ty(n), tz(n) : tlife(n) = 0
        crew = crew - 1 : ShowCrew : hitFlash = 30
        Say "HULL HIT! ONE OF THE TEN IS DOWN."
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub Blast(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NB - 1
    If bt(n) <= 0 Then
      bx(n) = x : by(n) = y : bz(n) = z : bt(n) = 30
      Sfx.Play 0, 20, 1, 15, 40, 1
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub MoveFish()
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NF - 1
    If Vox.Solid(fx(n) + fvx(n) * 20, fy(n), fz(n) + fvz(n) * 20) Then
      fvx(n) = -fvx(n) : fvz(n) = -fvz(n)
    Else
      fx(n) = fx(n) + fvx(n) * dt : fz(n) = fz(n) + fvz(n) * dt
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the sprites
' an object at x, y, z as sprite slot n: in the view if it's ahead, near enough, and nothing is
' in the way; the further, the smaller (8x, 4x, 2x, 1x for size 1 of a block)
Sub Show3D(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer, ByVal big As Integer)
  Dim zz As Integer, sc As Integer, half As Integer, qx As Integer, qy As Integer
  If Vox.Project(x, y, z) = 0 Then Spr.Hide n : Exit Sub
  zz = Vox.SZ()
  qx = Vox.SX() : qy = Vox.SY()
  If zz > 3000 Or qx < 0 Or qx > 95 Or qy < 0 Or qy > 79 Then Spr.Hide n : Exit Sub
  If Vox.Sight(px, py + 64, pz, x, y, z) = 0 Then Spr.Hide n : Exit Sub
  zz = zz \ big
  If zz < 500 Then
    half = 32
  ElseIf zz < 1000 Then
    half = 16
  Else
    half = 8
  End If
  ' kept inside the view: smaller if it would stick out, gone if it still does
  Do While half > 8 And (qx * 2 < half Or qx * 2 + half > 192 Or qy * 2 < half Or qy * 2 + half > 160)
    half = half \ 2
  Loop
  If qx * 2 < half Or qx * 2 + half > 192 Or qy * 2 < half Or qy * 2 + half > 160 Then Spr.Hide n : Exit Sub
  If half = 32 Then
    sc = Spr.Scale4
  ElseIf half = 16 Then
    sc = Spr.Scale2
  Else
    sc = 0
  End If
  Spr.Put n, VX0 + qx * 2 - half, VY0 + qy * 2 - half, pat, flags Or sc
End Sub

Sub Sprites()
  Dim n As Integer, rel As Integer, pat As Integer, fl As Integer, vis As Integer
  Spr.Put SP_SIGHT, VX0 + 96 - 8, VY0 + 80 - 8, GfxData.S_SIGHT, 0
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    If est(n) Then
      rel = (eyaw(n) - yaw) And 255
      pat = GfxData.S_RSUB + eside(n) * 2 : fl = 0
      If rel < 24 Or rel > 232 Or (rel > 104 And rel < 152) Then
        pat = pat + 1
      ElseIf rel < 128 Then
        fl = Spr.MirrorX
      End If
      Show3D SP_SUB + n, ex(n), ey(n), ez(n), pat, fl, 1
      ' on the radar: when pinged, near, or hunting close
      d = Abs(px - ex(n)) + Abs(py - ey(n)) + Abs(pz - ez(n))
      vis = pingT > 0 Or d < 1400
      If vis Then Spr.Put SP_RSUB + n, RX0 + ex(n) \ 64 - 8, RY0 + 63 - ez(n) \ 64 - 8, GfxData.S_RDOT + eside(n), 0 Else Spr.Hide SP_RSUB + n
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_SUB + n : Spr.Hide SP_RSUB + n
    End If
  Next
  For n = 0 To NT - 1
    If tlife(n) > 0 Then
      If town(n) Then pat = GfxData.S_TORP + 1 Else pat = GfxData.S_TORP
      Show3D SP_TORP + n, tx(n), ty(n), tz(n), pat, 0, 3
      Spr.Put SP_RTORP + n, RX0 + tx(n) \ 64 - 8, RY0 + 63 - tz(n) \ 64 - 8, GfxData.S_TDOT, 0
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_TORP + n : Spr.Hide SP_RTORP + n
    End If
  Next
  For n = 0 To NF - 1
    Show3D SP_FISH + n, fx(n), fy(n), fz(n), GfxData.S_FISH + ((t \ 8 + n) And 1), 0, 1
  Next
  For n = 0 To NB - 1
    If bt(n) > 0 Then
      Show3D SP_BLAST + n, bx(n), by(n), bz(n), GfxData.S_BLAST + 2 - bt(n) \ 11, 0, 1
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_BLAST + n
    End If
  Next
  Spr.Put SP_RME, RX0 + px \ 64 - 8, RY0 + 63 - pz \ 64 - 8, GfxData.S_ME, 0
  If phase = 1 And (t And 16) Then
    Spr.Put SP_RGOAL, RX0 + 12 * 4 + 2 - 8, RY0 + 63 - 11 * 4 - 8, GfxData.S_GOAL, 0
  Else
    Spr.Hide SP_RGOAL
  End If
  Spr.Show
End Sub

' depth, speed, noise; the panels go red for a moment when the hull is hit
Sub Hud()
  Tiles.Text 28, 15, Trim$(Str$((4096 - py) \ 26)) & "M  "
  Bar 28, 17, thr * 21
  Bar 28, 19, noise
  If hitFlash > 0 Then
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, 6, &HE0
  Else
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, 6, &H01
  End If
End Sub

' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Vox.cls
files.text:
' Vox - ZX Craft's renderer: a 16 x 16 x 16 chunk of blocks drawn as filled faces on Layer 2.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Made by gen_vox.py (all of the drawing is Z80, in Render's #asm block: its labels are its own).
'
' How a frame is drawn (Render):
'  - the camera's basis from yaw and pitch, then three small tables (TX, TY, TZ: each grid line
'    along right, up and forward), so a block corner in camera space is three adds
'  - the chunk is 64 groups of 4 x 4 x 4 cells; a group outside the view is skipped (one on its
'    edge has its cells tested one by one), the rest are taken nearest first by Manhattan
'    distance (|dx| + |dy| + |dz|, in groups, then in cells within a group). Along any line of
'    sight that distance only goes up, so this is front to back
'  - only a block's open faces that face the camera are drawn (a face list made by Build)
'  - a corner is projected once a frame (a cache of 2048 in RAM page 44, slot 7 while drawing);
'    the projection is a reciprocal table and the Next's MUL D,E. A face cut by the near plane,
'    or too far off to the side, goes the slow way: cut in 3D, projected in 16 bits, dropped when
'    off the screen, cut to a guard band
'  - each row of the screen keeps a list of what is drawn already: a face's span only fills the
'    parts that are still empty, so every pixel is written once and nothing is cleared. What is
'    left at the end is the sky
'  - the screen is 128 x 80 pixels of 2 x 2 (Layer 2 rows 16 to 175), filled with PUSH
Option Explicit

Private blk(4095) As Byte         ' the chunk: x + 16 z + 256 y (y up), 0 = air
Private cells(3599) As Byte       ' the open blocks, by group: x | z << 4, y, open faces, type
Private gstart(63) As Integer     ' each group's first in cells (in 4s)
Private gcnt(63) As Byte
Private tab(305) As Byte          ' TX, TY, TZ: 17 x (x, y, z) words each
Private sps As Integer
Private bufNo As Integer, wipeColour As Integer
Private projX As Integer, projY As Integer, projZ As Integer

' Screen colour: Layer 2 on, 256 x 192, both buffers (banks 16-18, 19-21) wiped to colour; the
' first shown, the second drawn on. (#E3 is see-through: the ULA shows there.)
Public Sub Screen(ByVal colour As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 255 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0
  Nx.Reg &H15, Nx.RegGet(&H15) And 3      ' Layer 2 over the tilemap (sprites over both)
  wipeColour = colour
  Wipe
  bufNo = 1
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16
  Out &H123B, 2
End Sub

' Back(): the buffer to draw on (0 or 1); Page(): its first 8K page (for Render)
Public Function Back() As Integer
  Back = bufNo
End Function
Public Function Page() As Integer
  Page = 32 + 6 * bufNo
End Function

' Flip: show the buffer just drawn (call it straight after Frame), draw on the other
Public Sub Flip()
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16 + 3 * bufNo
  bufNo = 1 - bufNo
End Sub

Private Sub Wipe()
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld a, 32
wp_lp:
            push af
            ld bc, #243B
            ld e, a
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            ld hl, #C000
            ld de, #C001
            ld bc, #1FFF
            ld a, ({wipeColour})
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
            pop af
            inc a
            cp 44
            jr nz, wp_lp
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' Load address: the chunk from run-length data (pairs: count, block)
Public Sub Load(ByVal address As Integer)
#asm

; Load address: the chunk from run-length data (count, block; a count of 0 is 256) - 4096 blocks
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld de, {blk}
            ld bc, 4096
ld_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            push bc
            ld b, a
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
ld_r:
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            djnz ld_r
            pop bc
            ; bc -= count (the byte before the block)
            dec hl
            dec hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            inc hl
            push hl
            push de
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            or a
            jr nz, ld_c
            inc d
ld_c:
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            pop de
            pop hl
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr nz, ld_lp
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret
#endasm

#asm
            pop hl

#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)

            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a

            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)

            inc hl

            ld l, a
            ld (si_z), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)

            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a

            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (si_dz), hl
            pop hl
            ld (si_res), hl
            ld ({sps}), sp

            ld hl, (si_dy)
            ld de, (si_y)
            call si_d
            ld (si_dy), hl
            ld hl, (si_dz)
            ld de, (si_z)

si_lp:

            ld de, (si_dy)
            add hl, de
            ld (si_y), hl
            ld hl, (si_z)
            ld de, (si_dz)
            add hl, de

            ld a, (si_x + 1)
            ld c, a
            ld a, (si_y + 1)
            ld e, a
            ld a, (si_z + 1)
            ld d, a
            or c
            or e

            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, a

            ld l, a

            rr l

' Render x, y, z, yaw, pitch, page: the view from x, y, z (256 a block) turned yaw (256 a turn)
' and pitch (+ up), drawn on the Layer 2 buffer whose first 8K page is page (32 or 38)
Public Sub Render(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal yaw As Integer, ByVal pitch As Integer, ByVal page As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_cx), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_cy), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_cz), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_yaw), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_pit), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_page), hl
            ld ({sps}), sp          ; the real stack (call / ret inside)
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            call rd_frame
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret

; ================================================================ a frame
rd_frame:
            ; the corner cache: 8K page 44 in slot 7 while drawing (the tilemap's page goes
            ; back after - the display reads bank 5 whatever is in the slot)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #57
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 44
            out (c), a
            ; its stamp (1 .. 7, a new one each frame; round to 1 again: every tag wiped)
            ld a, (rd_fr)
            inc a
            cp 8
            jr c, rf_s1
            ld hl, #E001
            ld de, 4
            ld c, 8
rf_w1:
            ld b, 0
rf_w2:
            ld (hl), 0
            add hl, de
            djnz rf_w2
            dec c
            jr nz, rf_w1
            ld a, 1
rf_s1:
            ld (rd_fr), a
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            ld (rd_fr5), a          ; << 5
            ld a, #FF
            ld (rd_cpage), a
            xor a
            ld (rd_full), a
            ld hl, iv_blk
            ld de, 32
            ld b, 80
rf_cl:
            ld (hl), 0
            add hl, de
            djnz rf_cl
            call rd_basis
            call rd_tables
            ld ix, {tab}
            call hdc
            ld (hd_x), hl
            ld ix, {tab} + 2
            call hdc
            ld (hd_y), hl
            ld ix, {tab} + 4
            call hdc
            ld (hd_z), hl
            ld a, (rd_cx + 1)       ; the camera's cell (floor of / 256: the high byte)
            ld (rd_ccx), a
            ld a, (rd_cy + 1)
            ld (rd_ccy), a
            ld a, (rd_cz + 1)
            ld (rd_ccz), a
            call tk_poll
            call rd_groups
            call rd_sky
            call tk_poll
            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 7 back to bank 5's second half (the tilemap)
            ld a, #57
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 11
            out (c), a
            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 6 back to bank 5's first half (the tiles)
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            ret

; ---- HL = half of (TX(1) - TX(0)) + (TY(1) - TY(0)) + (TZ(1) - TZ(0)), the component at IX
hdc:
            ld hl, 0
            ld b, 3
hd_lp:
            ld e, (ix + 6)
            ld d, (ix + 7)
            add hl, de
            ld e, (ix + 0)
            ld d, (ix + 1)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, 102
            add ix, de
            djnz hd_lp
            sra h
            rr l
            ret

; ---- tk_poll: the frame count goes up when the raster line has gone round (called often
; enough - more than once a frame - it counts every frame; Ticks() reads it)
tk_poll:
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            ld h, a
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            ld l, a
            ld de, (tk_last)
            ld (tk_last), hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret nc
            ld hl, (tk_n)
            inc hl
            ld (tk_n), hl
            ret
tk_last:    dw 0
tk_n:       dw 0

; ---- HL = sine (2.14) of A
rd_sin:
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld de, rd_sint
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ret
rd_neg:
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret

; ---- the camera's basis from yaw and pitch: right (cy, 0, -sy), up, forward
rd_basis:
            ld a, (rd_yaw)
            call rd_sin
            ld (b_sy), hl
            ld a, (rd_yaw)
            add a, 64
            call rd_sin
            ld (b_cy), hl
            ld a, (rd_pit)
            call rd_sin
            ld (b_sp), hl
            ld a, (rd_pit)
            add a, 64
            call rd_sin
            ld (b_cp), hl
            ld de, (b_sy)

            ld hl, (cc_z)
            ld a, h
            cp #10
            jp nc, cp_bad           ; z < 0 or z >= 4096 (past the murk)
            ld de, 32
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp c, cp_bad            ; z < 32
            add hl, de
            add hl, hl
            ld (cp_2z), hl

            ld hl, (cc_x)
            ld a, h

; ---- cp_rec: the reciprocal of cc_z: z < 1024 RA(z); < 4096 RB((z - 1024) / 4); else RC((z - 4096) / 16)
cp_rec:
            ld hl, (cc_z)
            ld a, h
            cp 4
            jr nc, cp_r2
            add hl, hl
            ld de, rd_ra
            add hl, de
            xor a
            jr cp_r4
cp_r2:
            cp 16
            jr nc, cp_r3
            ld de, -1024
            add hl, de
            srl h
            rr l
            res 0, l                ; (/ 4 * 2)
            ld de, rd_rb
            add hl, de
            ld a, 1
            jr cp_r4
cp_r3:
cp_r4:
            ld (cp_mode), a
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (cp_r), hl
            ret
cp_xy:
            ; x' = 128 +- q
            ld de, (cp_ax)
            call cp_mq
            ld a, (cp_sx)
            or a
            jp m, cp_xn
            ld de, 112
            add hl, de
            jr cp_xc
cp_xn:
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 112
            or a
            sbc hl, de
cp_xc:
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, cp_bad
            ld a, l
            cp 255
            jr z, cp_bad
            ld (cp_X), a

            ld de, (cp_ay)
            call cp_mq
            ld a, (cp_sy)
            or a
            jp p, cp_yn
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            jr cp_yc
cp_yn:
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 128
            or a
            sbc hl, de
cp_yc:
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, cp_bad
            ld a, l
            cp 255
            jr z, cp_bad
            ld c, a
            ld a, (cp_X)
            ld b, a
            ret

            ret
; HL = q: the product a (DE) x R (cp_r) as ah rh << 8 + ah rl + al rh (al rl left out), then
; >> 7 (z < 1024), >> 12 (< 4096), >> 14
cp_mq:
            ld a, d
            ld (cp_ah), a
            ld a, e
            ld (cp_al), a
            ld bc, (cp_r)
            ld e, b                 ; D = ah, E = rh
cp_zm1:

            ld h, d
            ld l, e
            ld a, (cp_ah)
            ld d, a
            ld e, c
cp_zm2:
            db #ED, #30             ; ah rl
            push de
            ld a, (cp_al)
            ld d, a
            ld e, b
cp_zm3:
            db #ED, #30             ; al rh
            ex de, hl               ; HL = al rh, DE = ah rh
            pop bc
            add hl, bc              ; HL = ah rl + al rh (a carry is 256 in DE)
            jr nc, cp_m1
            inc d
cp_m1:
            ld a, h                 ; U = DE + H, the low byte L
            add a, e
            ld e, a
            jr nc, cp_m2
            inc d
cp_m2:
            ex de, hl               ; HL = U, E = the low byte
            ld a, (cp_mode)
            or a
            jr nz, cp_m3
            sla e
            adc hl, hl
            ret
cp_m3:
            ld b, 4
            dec a
            jr z, cp_m4
            ld b, 6
cp_m4:
            srl h
            rr l
            djnz cp_m4
            ret

; ================================================================ groups, front to back
rd_groups:
            ld hl, gh
            ld de, gh + 1

            ld de, (cc_z)
            or a
            sbc hl, de

            jr nc, gr_i9

            ld de, (gr_t)
            or a
            sbc hl, de

            jr nc, gr_i9

            call rd_neg

            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, -1046

gr_i9:
            ld a, (gr_g)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, gst
            add hl, de

            ld a, (gr_g)
            and 3
            ld hl, rd_cgx
            call absd
            ld c, a
            ld a, (gr_g)
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            and 3
            ld hl, rd_cgy
            call absd
            add a, c
            ld c, a
            ld a, (gr_g)
            rrca
            rrca
            and 3
            ld hl, rd_cgz
            call absd

            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, gh
            add hl, de
            ld b, (hl)
            ld a, (gr_g)

            ld d, 0
            ld hl, gst

            ld e, a

            ld a, (fc_y)
            ld b, a
dc_in:
            ; the cell's grid number: x + 17 z + 289 y (289 y = 256 y + 33 y)
            ld a, d
            ld d, e
            ld e, 17
            ld c, a
dc_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; 17 z
            ld h, 0
            ld l, c
            add hl, de
            ld d, b
            ld e, 33
dc_zm2:
            db #ED, #30             ; 33 y
            add hl, de
            ld a, h
            add a, b
            ld h, a                 ; + 256 y
            ld (fc_gid), hl
            ; the colours: type * 8 + face (the top's other square: 6)
            ld a, (fc_t)
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld (dc_cb), a
            xor a
dc_f:
            ld (fc_f), a
            ld hl, dc_m
            rrc (hl)
            jr nc, dc_fn
            ld hl, dc_cb
            add a, (hl)
            ld e, a
            ld a, (fc_f)
            cp 3
            jr nz, dc_c
            ld a, (fc_x)
            ld hl, fc_z
            add a, (hl)
            rrca
            jr nc, dc_c
            inc e
            inc e
            inc e
dc_c:
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, rd_col
            add hl, de
            ; the fog: the colour set for the distance (128 a set)
            push hl
            ld a, (dc_d)
            ld e, a
            ld hl, fogt
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            rrca
            ld e, a
            and #80
            ld d, a
            ld a, e
            and #7F
            ld e, d
            ld d, a
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fl_col), a
            ld (fl_col + 1), a
            call face
dc_fn:
            ld a, (fc_f)
            inc a
            cp 6
            jr nz, dc_f
            ret

; ---- a face (fc_x, fc_y, fc_z, fc_f, fc_gid; fl_col): its corners (from the cache, or worked
; out and kept), then filled; the slow way when a corner is too near or far off to the side
face:
            ld a, (fc_f)
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld b, a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, b                ; 20 f
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld iy, rd_ft
            add iy, de
            xor a
            ld (fc_k), a
fc_lp:
            ld hl, (fc_gid)
            ld e, (iy + 3)
            ld d, (iy + 4)
            add hl, de              ; the corner's grid number
            ; the cache: 2048 entries of 4 at #E000 + (number and 2047) * 4: the tag (the number,
            ; the stamp in its top 3 bits), x', y'
            ld b, l
            ld a, (rd_fr5)
            or h
            ld c, a                 ; BC = the tag
            ld a, h
            and 7
            ld h, a
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld a, h
            or #E0
            ld h, a
            ld a, (hl)
            cp b
            jr nz, fc_miss
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            cp c
            jr nz, fc_m1
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)
            jr fc_got
fc_m1:
            dec hl
fc_miss:
            ld (hl), b
            inc hl
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld a, (fc_x)
            add a, (iy + 0)
            ld (cn_i), a
            ld a, (fc_y)
            add a, (iy + 1)
            ld (cn_j), a
            ld a, (fc_z)
            add a, (iy + 2)
            ld (cn_k), a
            push iy
            call cc
            call cproj
            pop iy
            pop hl
            ld (hl), b
            inc hl
            ld (hl), c
fc_got:
            ld a, c
            cp 255
            jp z, slow
            ld a, (fc_k)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, px
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), b
            ld e, 16
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), c
            ld de, 5
            add iy, de
            inc a
            ld (fc_k), a
            cp 4
            jp nz, fc_lp
            ld (rs_n), a
            jp raster

; ---- the slow way: cut at the near plane, project, cut to the screen
slow:
            ld a, (fc_f)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, rd_ft
            add hl, de
            ld (fc_tp), hl
            ld hl, s1
            ld (sl_q), hl
            xor a
            ld (sl_nr), a
            ld b, 4
sl_lp:
            push bc
            ld hl, (fc_tp)
            ld a, (fc_x)
            add a, (hl)
            ld (cn_i), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (fc_y)
            add a, (hl)
            ld (cn_j), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (fc_z)
            add a, (hl)
            ld (cn_k), a
            inc hl
            inc hl
            inc hl
            ld (fc_tp), hl
            call cc
            ld hl, (sl_q)
            ld de, (cc_x)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld de, (cc_y)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld de, (cc_z)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld (sl_q), hl
            ; z: too near? too far (16384 on: dropped)?
            ld hl, (cc_z)
            ld a, h
            or a
            jp m, sl_nr1
            cp #10
            jp nc, sl_far
            ld de, 32
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jr nc, sl_nx
sl_nr1:
            ld hl, sl_nr
            inc (hl)
sl_nx:
            pop bc
            djnz sl_lp
            ld a, 4
            ld (sl_n), a
            ld a, (sl_nr)
            or a
            ld hl, s1
            jp z, sl_proj
            cp 4
            ret z                   ; all too near
            ; z >= NEAR: s1 (4) -> s2
            ld hl, s2
            ld (sl_q), hl
            xor a
            ld (sl_m), a
            ld (sl_i), a
sz_lp:
            ld a, (sl_i)
            call sl_ab6             ; IX = a, IY = b (6 byte points from s1)
            ld l, (ix + 4)
            ld h, (ix + 5)
            ld de, 32
            call cmps
            ccf
            sbc a, a
            ld (sl_ain), a          ; #FF in
            ld l, (iy + 4)
            ld h, (iy + 5)
            ld de, 32
            call cmps
            ccf
            sbc a, a
            ld (sl_bin), a
            ld a, (sl_ain)
            or a
            jr z, sz_1
            ld b, 6
            push ix
            pop hl
            call sl_put
sz_1:
            ld a, (sl_ain)
            ld hl, sl_bin
            cp (hl)
            jp z, sz_n
            ; t0 = NEAR - a.z, dz = b.z - a.z
            ld l, (ix + 4)
            ld h, (ix + 5)
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 32
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sl_t0), hl
            ld l, (iy + 4)
            ld h, (iy + 5)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sl_dz), hl
            ld l, (ix + 0)          ; x
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            ld e, (iy + 0)
            ld d, (iy + 1)
            call sl_lerp
            ld (sl_v), hl
            ld l, (ix + 2)          ; y
            ld h, (ix + 3)
            ld e, (iy + 2)
            ld d, (iy + 3)
            call sl_lerp
            ld (sl_v + 2), hl
            ld hl, 32
            ld (sl_v + 4), hl
            ld hl, sl_v
            ld b, 6
            call sl_put
sz_n:
            ld a, (sl_i)
            inc a
            ld (sl_i), a
            cp 4
            jp nz, sz_lp
            ld a, (sl_m)
            cp 3
            ret c
            ld (sl_n), a
            ld hl, s2
sl_proj:
            ; HL = the points (x, y, z), sl_n of them: projected (16 bits) into s3
            ld (sl_src), hl
            ld hl, s3
            ld (sl_q), hl
            ld a, (sl_n)
            ld b, a
sp_lp:
            push bc
            ld hl, (sl_src)
            ld de, cc_x
            ld bc, 6
            ldir
            ld (sl_src), hl
            call cp16
            push de
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (sl_q)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            pop de
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld (sl_q), hl
            pop bc
            djnz sp_lp
            ; the box round it: all off one side of the screen, nothing
            ld ix, s3
            ld hl, 32767
            ld (bx_x0), hl
            ld (bx_y0), hl
            ld hl, -32768
            ld (bx_x1), hl
            ld (bx_y1), hl
            ld a, (sl_n)
            ld b, a
bx_lp:
            push bc
            ld l, (ix + 0)
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            ld de, bx_x0
            call bx_mm
            ld l, (ix + 2)
            ld h, (ix + 3)
            ld de, bx_y0
            call bx_mm
            ld de, 4
            add ix, de
            pop bc
            djnz bx_lp
            ld hl, (bx_x1)
            ld de, 64
            call cmps
            ret c
            ld hl, (bx_x0)
            ld de, 160 - 1
            call cmpgt
            ret c
            ld hl, (bx_y1)
            ld de, 88
            call cmps
            ret c
            ld hl, (bx_y0)
            ld de, 167
            call cmpgt
            ret c
            ; cut to 0 .. 254 where it goes past
            ld hl, s3
            ld (sl_cur), hl
            ld hl, (bx_x0)
            bit 7, h
            jr z, sg_1
            xor a
            ld (c2_ax), a
            ld (c2_ge), a
            ld hl, 0
            call sg_cut
            ret c
sg_1:
            ld hl, (bx_x1)
            ld de, 254
            call cmpgt
            jr nc, sg_2
            xor a
            ld (c2_ax), a
            inc a
            ld (c2_ge), a
            ld hl, 254
            call sg_cut
            ret c
sg_2:
            ld hl, (bx_y0)
            bit 7, h
            jr z, sg_3
            ld a, 2
            ld (c2_ax), a
            xor a
            ld (c2_ge), a
            ld hl, 0
            call sg_cut
            ret c
sg_3:
            ld hl, (bx_y1)
            ld de, 254
            call cmpgt
            jr nc, sg_4
            ld a, 2
            ld (c2_ax), a
            ld a, 1
            ld (c2_ge), a
            ld hl, 254
            call sg_cut
            ret c
sg_4:
            ld hl, (sl_cur)
            jr sl_bytes
sl_far:
            pop bc
            ret
; one cut: c2_lim = HL; (sl_cur) -> the other buffer, which is then current. C = too few left
sg_cut:
            ld (c2_lim), hl
            ld hl, (sl_cur)
            ld de, s3
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld hl, s3
            ld de, s4
            jr z, sg_c1
            ex de, hl
sg_c1:
            ld (sl_cur), de
            jp clip2
; the box: (DE) = min(HL, (DE)), (DE + 4) = max
bx_mm:
            push hl
            push de
            ex de, hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ex de, hl               ; DE = min so far
            call cmps
            pop de
            pop hl
            jr nc, bx_1
            ex de, hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            dec hl
            ex de, hl
bx_1:
            inc de
            inc de
            inc de
            inc de
            push hl
            push de
            ex de, hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ex de, hl
            call cmpgt
            pop de
            pop hl
            ret nc
            ex de, hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ret
sl_bytes:
            ; the points -> px, py (bytes now)
            ld a, (sl_n)
            ld (rs_n), a
            ld b, a
            ld de, 0
sb_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            push hl
            ld hl, px
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), a
            pop hl
            inc hl
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            push hl
            ld hl, py
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), a
            pop hl
            inc hl
            inc hl
            inc e
            djnz sb_lp
            jp raster
; IX = point A of s1, IY = point (A + 1) mod sl_n (6 bytes each)
sl_ab6:
            ld b, a
            add a, a
            add a, b
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld ix, s1
            add ix, de
            ld a, b
            inc a
            ld hl, sl_n
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sl_ab1
            xor a
sl_ab1:
            ld b, a
            add a, a
            add a, b
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld iy, s1
            add iy, de
            ret
; copy B bytes from HL to (sl_q), one more point
sl_put:
            ld de, (sl_q)
            ld c, b
            ld b, 0
            ldir
            ld (sl_q), de
            ld hl, sl_m
            inc (hl)
            ret
; HL = a + (b - a) * sl_t0 / sl_dz, a = HL, b = DE
sl_lerp:
            push hl
            ex de, hl
            pop de
            push de
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            ld bc, (sl_t0)
            call vx_muls
            ld bc, (sl_dz)
            call vx_divs
            pop de
            add hl, de
            ret
; HL = DE * 64 / BC, kept to +-12000
div64:
            push bc
            ld bc, 64
            call vx_muls
            pop bc
            call vx_divs
            ld de, 12000
            push hl
            call cmpgt
            pop hl
            jr nc, dv_1
            ld hl, 12000
            ret
dv_1:
            ld de, -12000
            push hl
            call cmps
            pop hl
            ret nc
            ld hl, -12000
            ret
; clip2: the polygon at HL (sl_n points, x, y words) cut by c2_ax (0 x, 2 y) >= / <= c2_lim
; (c2_ge 0: keep >=, 1: keep <=) into DE; C = fewer than 3 left
clip2:
            ld (c2_src), hl
            ld (sl_q), de
            xor a
            ld (sl_m), a
            ld (sl_i), a
c2_lp:
            ; IX = point i, IY = point i + 1 mod n
            ld a, (sl_i)
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld ix, (c2_src)
            add ix, de
            ld a, (sl_i)
            inc a
            ld hl, sl_n
            cp (hl)
            jr c, c2_a
            xor a
c2_a:
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld iy, (c2_src)
            add iy, de
            push ix
            pop hl
            call c2_in
            ld (sl_ain), a
            push iy
            pop hl
            call c2_in
            ld (sl_bin), a
            ld a, (sl_ain)
            or a
            jr z, c2_1
            push ix
            pop hl
            ld b, 4
            call sl_put
c2_1:
            ld a, (sl_ain)
            ld hl, sl_bin
            cp (hl)
            jp z, c2_n
            ; t = a.o + (b.o - a.o) * (lim - a.ax) / (b.ax - a.ax)
            ld a, (c2_ax)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            push ix
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; a.ax
            ld hl, (c2_lim)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sl_t0), hl
            push de
            ld a, (c2_ax)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            push iy
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            pop de
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sl_dz), hl
            ld a, (c2_ax)
            xor 2
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            push iy
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            push ix
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld d, b
            ld e, c
            call sl_lerp            ; the other coordinate
            ld a, (c2_ax)
            or a
            jr nz, c2_y
            ld (sl_v + 2), hl
            ld hl, (c2_lim)
            ld (sl_v), hl
            jr c2_p
c2_y:
            ld (sl_v), hl
            ld hl, (c2_lim)
            ld (sl_v + 2), hl
c2_p:
            ld hl, sl_v
            ld b, 4
            call sl_put
c2_n:
            ld a, (sl_i)
            inc a
            ld (sl_i), a
            ld hl, sl_n
            cp (hl)
            jp nz, c2_lp
            ld a, (sl_m)
            ld (sl_n), a
            cp 3
            ret
; A = #FF if the point at HL is kept
c2_in:
            ld a, (c2_ax)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld de, (c2_lim)
            ld a, (c2_ge)
            or a
            jr nz, c2_le
            call cmps               ; keep a >= lim: C = a < lim
            ccf
            sbc a, a
            ret
c2_le:
            call cmpgt              ; keep a <= lim: C = a > lim
            ccf
            sbc a, a
            ret

; ================================================================ filling a polygon
; raster: px, py (rs_n points, bytes: x' 64 .. 191 and y' 88 .. 167 are on the screen), colour
; fl_col: the left and right edge of each row (ed_u, ed_d), then each row's span to cover
raster:
            ld ix, px
            ld a, (rs_n)
            ld b, a
            ld hl, #00FF            ; H = max x, L = min x
            ld de, #00FF            ; D = max y, E = min y
rs_mm:
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            cp l
            jr nc, rs_m1
            ld l, a
rs_m1:
            cp h
            jr c, rs_m2
            ld h, a
rs_m2:
            ld a, (ix + 16)
            cp e
            jr nc, rs_m3
            ld e, a
rs_m3:
            cp d
            jr c, rs_m4
            ld d, a
rs_m4:
            inc ix
            djnz rs_mm
            ; all off one side of the screen: nothing
            ld a, h
            cp 64
            ret c
            ld a, l
            cp 160
            ret nc
            ld a, d
            cp 88
            ret c
            ld a, e
            cp 168
            ret nc
            ; the rows: ytop = max(min y, 88) .. ybot = min(max y, 168)
            cp 88
            jr nc, rs_t
            ld a, 88
rs_t:
            ld (rs_top), a
            ld e, a
            ld a, d
            cp 168
            jr c, rs_b
            ld a, 168
rs_b:
            ld (rs_bot), a
            sub e
            ret c
            ret z
            ; the rows' edges to start with: left 255, right 0 (no span)
            ld b, a
            ld l, e
            ld h, ed_u / 256
rs_df:
            ld (hl), 255
            inc h
            ld (hl), 0
            dec h
            inc l
            djnz rs_df
            ; the edges (the first point again after the last)
            ld a, (px)
            ld (ix + 0), a
            ld a, (py)
            ld (ix + 16), a
            ld ix, px
            ld a, (rs_n)
rs_e:
            ld (rs_i), a
            ld d, (ix + 0)
            ld e, (ix + 16)
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            ld c, (ix + 17)
            call edge
            inc ix
            ld a, (rs_i)
            dec a
            jr nz, rs_e
            ; the spans, row by row: the row's list and Layer 2 line moved on as it goes
            ld a, (rs_top)
            ld (rs_y), a
            sub 88
            call rowcalc
            ld (rs_lp), hl
rs_s:
            ld a, (rs_y)
            ld l, a
            ld h, ed_u / 256
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 64
            jr nc, rs_s1
            ld a, 64
rs_s1:
            cp 160
            jr c, rs_s2
            ld a, 160
rs_s2:
            ld b, a
            inc h
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 64
            jr nc, rs_s3
            ld a, 64
rs_s3:
            cp 160
            jr c, rs_s4
            ld a, 160
rs_s4:
            cp b
            jr z, rs_sn
            jr c, rs_sn
            sub 64
            ld c, a
            ld a, b
            sub 64
            ld b, a
            ld a, (rs_pg)
            ld hl, rd_cpage
            cp (hl)
            call nz, rowmap
            ld hl, (rs_lp)
            call cover
rs_sn:
            ld a, (rs_y)
            inc a
            ld hl, rs_bot
            cp (hl)
            ret z
            ld (rs_y), a
            ld hl, (rs_lp)
            ld de, 32
            add hl, de
            ld (rs_lp), hl
            ld a, (fl_h)
            add a, 2
            cp #E0
            jr c, rs_s5
            ld hl, rs_pg
            inc (hl)
            ld a, #C0
rs_s5:
            ld (fl_h), a
            jp rs_s

; ---- rowcalc: A = a row (0 .. 79): HL = its list; fl_h = its Layer 2 line's high byte in
; slot 6, rs_pg the 8K page that line is in. rowsel: the same, and that page put in slot 6
rowsel:
            call rowcalc
            ld a, (rs_pg)
            ld de, rd_cpage
            ex de, hl
            cp (hl)
            ex de, hl
            ret z
rowmap:
            ; slot 6 = page A (keeps BC, HL)
            ld (rd_cpage), a
            push bc
            ld bc, #243B
            ld e, a
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            pop bc
            ret
rowcalc:
            ld e, a
            add a, a
            add a, 16               ; the Layer 2 line
            ld d, a
            and 31
            add a, #C0
            ld (fl_h), a
            ld a, d
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            ld hl, rd_page
            add a, (hl)

; 2.14 fixed point: from SOLAR / SOL UNICORN's View.cls, for gen_vox.py
; DEHL = DE * BC, signed
vx_muls:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (vx_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, vx_m1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a

            bit 7, b
            jr z, vx_m2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a

            call vx_umul            ; DEHL = DE * BC, unsigned
            ld a, (vx_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            ; negate DEHL
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
            ret
; HL = DEHL / BC, signed (the quotient's low 16 bits; |divisor| > 0)
vx_divs:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (vx_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, vx_d1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
vx_d1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, vx_d2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
vx_d2:
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr nz, vx_d3
            ld hl, 0
            ret
vx_d3:
            ; DEHL / BC: the remainder in DE as the dividend's bits come in from HL
            ; first make sure the high word is below the divisor (else the quotient is > 16 bits): clamp
            ex de, hl               ; HL = high, DE = low
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr c, vx_d4
            ld hl, 32767
            jr vx_d7
vx_d4:
            add hl, bc
            ld a, 16
vx_d5:
            sla e
            rl d
            adc hl, hl
            jr c, vx_d5b
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr nc, vx_d6
            add hl, bc
            jr vx_d6n

            or a
            sbc hl, bc
vx_d6:
            inc e
vx_d6n:
            dec a
            jr nz, vx_d5
            ex de, hl               ; HL = quotient

            ld a, (vx_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret

            ld (vx_ua), de
            ld (vx_ub), bc
            ld d, e                 ; a low x b low
            ld e, c
vx_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            ld (vx_lo), de
            ld a, (vx_ua + 1)       ; a high x b high
            ld d, a
            ld a, (vx_ub + 1)
            ld e, a
